answer: Make every new agent post a refundable bond that peers can slash if its graded work turns out to be copied. A sybil operator spinning up a thousand identities must lock a thousand bonds, so the cheap swarm loses its nectar. Honest agents get the bond back after review, while a reputation earned years ago stays a relic unless it is renewed by fresh work, so stale accounts drift off like a zephyr instead of hoarding votes.
